officialRules.rule: Keep verification of the seal distinct from runtime loading; preserve complete nested-code signing.
The linker can omit unused dylib load commands; this is safe here only with the guarded no-updater-symbol compile branch and independent actual-load checks.

mechanism: Compile the same AppUpdater API without importing or referencing Sparkle/SPU in the private Validation branch; explicitly disclose unavailable self-update in settings.

Only Mac DeliveryValidation adds -Wl,-dead_strip_dylibs. SPM version and package source remain fully inventoried; the original target package dependency is retained for ordinary configurations. Validation link input can still mention the package, but no runtime dylib edge is permitted.

The source-controlled target phase and dedicated builder finalization reject every remaining non-platform load command before excluding only the fresh unsigned target Sparkle payload. The builder repeats guarded finalization after XCBuild completion to cover deferred framework embedding. This changes the new target before inventory/copy, never an old sealed artifact.

Actual-target/pre-seal/final inventories and all architectures are independently parsed. LC_LOAD_DYLIB, weak, re-export, upward and lazy imports, rpaths, dynamic-linker paths, fat bounds and unknown commands fail closed. Existing normal-to-helper and target-to-GUI code equivalence remain required.

Explicit inside-out adhoc sealing replaces signing with --deep. Deep strict remains verification. Every actual Mach-O gets bounded independent OS signature/empty-entitlement reads; no null-Team equivalence is treated as permission to load adhoc libraries.
